Elon’s net worth is roughly $1 trillion right now — but almost none of it is cash in a bank. It’s mostly stock in Tesla and SpaceX.
You can’t just “sell all of it” like cashing out a savings account. Dumping that much stock at once would crash the share prices hard. The paper value would evaporate on the way down. Employees with options, pension funds, and regular investors holding the stock would all get crushed too.

UPDATE: Elon Musk has confirmed Starmind as the name of SpaceX's future AI satellite constellation.

Unlike Starlink, which moves data around the world, Starmind is designed to process AI workloads directly in orbit and beam the results back to Earth.

The first AI1 test satellites are currently targeted for launch in early 2027.

SpaceX isn't just building the internet in space. It may soon be building AI infrastructure in space too.
